subject: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte Posts Bail After Arrest
posts:
High-stakes political warfare erupts in Manila as Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail following an arrest warrant over alleged grave threats.
Evidence: Duterte posts bail, denies threats, cites political harassment
#Aletheia #Philippines

Duterte frames the arrest warrant as targeted political harassment by the Marcos administration, asserting her right to legal defense.
